tasks.short: Demonstrate exercise routines and equipment use

steps.what: Read the participant's programme and applicable equipment instructions
Set up and check exercise equipment for the demonstration
Demonstrate correct equipment use and performance of exercise routines
Observe participant practice and correct technique or understanding

tasks.design: Configure a native current-programme view in the {OTHER} exercise-record system with links to existing {DOCS} equipment instructions. Keep all physical setup, demonstration and participant correction with the physiologist; no video substitute or new demonstration log is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current programme can take several clicks, but safe demonstration is physical and individual.
tasks.enabler_now: Native programme views can reduce a little repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment fit and participant movement need direct checking.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist notices unsafe technique and adapts the demonstration immediately.
tasks.altitude: Almost unchanged demonstration work and authority.

reach.task: Teach safe equipment use through demonstration

evidence.claim: Native current-programme views can reduce navigation; this is model knowledge and does not automate physical exercise instruction.

assumptions: Boundary is demonstration and checking practice. Actual programme specification is separately decomposed in 19199 and participant data capture and progress recording in 19195; no record write is hidden in the demonstration.

The programme author supplies participant identifier, programme version, selected exercise and equipment. Missing or inconsistent instructions are checked manually within s1 and s2; no new structured feed is assumed.

Test native current-programme views first. One of ten reading hours is navigation, while nine hours of substantive reading remain. Physical work retains all ninety hours. No extra routine attendance record, report or send is invented.
unknowns: Whether current programme context is already visible
Any actual separate demonstration record required locally
research_questions: Does a native current-programme view remove any navigation still performed today?

already_counted.description: Read the actual programme and instruction meaning

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: one navigation hour removed less 0.2 upkeep gives 0.8. Cautious case: the existing session screen already shows the programme, so all ten reading hours remain and no additional view is maintained. Demonstration and physical correction are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prescribe individual exercise programmes and equipment

steps.what: Review participant assessment, contraindications and existing exercise response
Discuss goals, symptoms and practical equipment access with the participant
Choose individual exercises, equipment, intensity and progression conditions
Write the individual exercise programme and its specified equipment
Check the final prescription against participant needs and equipment constraints
Issue the checked individual exercise prescription to the participant

tasks.design: Configure the native programme form in the {OTHER} exercise-record system with existing participant headers and reusable section layout. The physiologist chooses and first enters all individual exercise and equipment settings, checks the final programme and personally issues it to the participant.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme writing repeats headings and identity context but depends on new individual clinical choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse layout and existing context without selecting exercise intensity or equipment.
tasks.still_hard: The appropriate programme depends on symptoms, response and practical equipment access.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist balances progress and tolerance and specifies appropriate individual conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less form assembly; prescription decisions and authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Functional goals, equipment limitations and progression conditions

evidence.claim: Native programme forms can reuse headings and existing participant context; this is model knowledge, not evidence for automated exercise prescribing.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual individual exercise prescription and issuance. Local professional scope is unchanged; no medication order or autonomous prescription is introduced.

Existing assessment records supply participant identifier, relevant findings and response history. The participant clarifies goals and access in s2. The physiologist produces exercise, equipment, frequency, duration, intensity and progression conditions in s3 and first enters them in s4; missing assessment context is manually checked in retained work.

Test native programme forms first. Five of twenty-five writing hours are repeated headings and existing identity context; twenty remain for actual specification and checking. Ordinary same-system author saving stays within those twenty hours, ungated and unchanged.

The positive-time final check follows writing and gates only issuing that exact prescription to that participant. Changed settings or recipient require a new check. All one-hour issuance time remains; it is not a claimed save.
unknowns: Which programme sections are genuinely reusable
research_questions: Can the current form reduce repeated context without preselecting clinical settings?

already_counted.description: First specify the individual programme and check its final clinical meaning

incremental.description: Maintain programme-form layout and verify default context fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact exercise programme, equipment settings and participant identity checked in s5; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: five repeated form-assembly hours removed less one upkeep hour gives 4. Cautious case: unusual equipment or an already optimised current form leaves all twenty-five specification hours necessary; no extra template is maintained. Assessment, discussion, exercise choices, final checking and actual issuance remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret participant data and evaluate programme changes

steps.what: Obtain existing participant measurements and first capture missing reported context
Align comparable participant measures, dates and units across sessions
Prepare participant progress tables and trend displays from verified measures
Interpret participant progress and identify clinically appropriate programme changes
First record and verify the actual progress assessment and reasons for change
Save the author's progress assessment entry

tasks.design: Configure native comparable-session views in the {OTHER} exercise-record system and a linked {SPREADSHEET} trend template. Retain missing-context capture, incompatible-measure repair and the physiologist's interpretation and first progress entry; no automatic programme change is made.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data alignment and display preparation can repeat while progress still needs clinical interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native session views and display templates can reuse existing dated measures.
tasks.still_hard: Different protocols, symptoms and missing sessions can make apparent trends misleading.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist weighs the participant's response and context before identifying a needed change.
tasks.altitude: Less data alignment and display assembly; clinical interpretation and programme decisions remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Comparable measures and context-aware progress interpretation

evidence.claim: Comparable-session views and trend templates can reuse dated measurement fields; this is model knowledge, not evidence that progress interpretation can be automated.

assumptions: Boundary is evaluation and its actual clinical entry; issuing a revised prescription is explicitly decomposed in 19199. No new progress-report send or routine engagement log is introduced.

Session staff, devices or participants supply participant identifier, session date, protocol, measure, unit and value where recorded. The physiologist verifies the actual sources and first enters missing reported context in s1. No clean sensor feed or unpaid new reporting task is assumed.

Test native comparable-session views first. Eight of twenty alignment hours are repeat field matching and unit placement; twelve remain for incompatible protocols and missing metadata. Six of fifteen display hours are repeated table and chart setup; nine remain for label and comparability checks. Existing calculation runtime earns no saving.
All thirty interpretation hours, fourteen first assessment-entry hours and the one-hour ordinary author save remain. Saving is ungated and gives no benefit. No model selects clinical changes.
unknowns: Consistency of session protocol and unit metadata
Whether native displays already eliminate assembly
research_questions: Can sessions be compared without hiding changed protocols or missing measurements?

already_counted.description: Repair incompatible measures, check displays and first record the clinical assessment

incremental.description: Maintain measure mappings and verify display labels after system changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: eight alignment hours and six display-setup hours removed, less 1.5 upkeep, gives 12.5. Cautious case: mixed protocols and missing units retain all twenty alignment hours; repeated display layout still removes six hours, less 1.5 upkeep, giving 4.5. Context capture, interpretation, first assessment writing and saving remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend ways to increase lifestyle physical activity

steps.what: Discuss current routines, practical barriers and preferred everyday activities
Read relevant health context and current activity guidance
Choose realistic methods to increase the participant's lifestyle physical activity
Recommend practical activity changes and agree feasible next actions
First record and verify the actual lifestyle advice and agreed actions
Save the author's lifestyle advice entry

tasks.design: Configure native advice-entry headings and current-participant context in the {OTHER} exercise-record system. Keep discovering barriers, choosing realistic methods and explaining advice with the physiologist; the actual advice is first entered and checked rather than generated from a generic recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Everyday activity advice depends on the person's life, while entry headings and context can repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record templates can remove repeated heading and context entry without choosing advice.
tasks.still_hard: A theoretically useful activity change may be impractical or unacceptable to the participant.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist negotiates feasible changes that fit the participant's health and daily circumstances.
tasks.altitude: A little less entry preparation; advice and shared decision-making remain unchanged.

reach.task: Adapt daily routines around a person's practical limitations
reach.learn: Feasible habit changes and environmental barriers

evidence.claim: Native clinical-entry templates can reuse headings and existing participant context; this is model knowledge, not evidence for automated lifestyle counselling.

assumptions: Boundary is everyday lifestyle advice and the actual clinical entry used at follow-up, distinct from equipment-specific exercise prescription in 19199. No separate handout, message or engagement report is invented.

The participant produces routine and barrier facts in s1. Existing records supply identity and relevant health context. The physiologist first writes the actual recommendation and agreed actions in s5, retaining 12.6 of fourteen hours for that substantive capture and verification.

Test native headings and current-participant context first. Only 1.4 hours of repeated heading and context preparation are removed. No structured lifestyle feed, automatic activity target or default clinical recommendation is assumed.
The one-hour ordinary same-system author save stays fully retained and ungated. All eighty-five discussion, reading and judgement hours remain.
unknowns: Whether advice-entry headings are already supplied
How advice is actually recorded for follow-up
research_questions: Does native entry configuration remove repeated headings without introducing generic clinical advice?

already_counted.description: First enter and verify the individual's actual advice and agreed actions

incremental.description: Check entry headings and context fields after record-system changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: 1.4 repeated entry-preparation hours removed less 0.3 upkeep gives 1.1. Cautious case: the current encounter form already supplies the headings and participant context; all fifteen entry and save hours remain and no additional template is maintained. Individual advice and discussion are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Exercise choices, demonstrations and lifestyle conversations remain human. Native forms and comparable-session displays may remove repeated entry preparation and display setup.
reach: Physical therapist: interpret comparable session response
Occupational therapist: adapt everyday activity to practical barriers
skills_to_grow: Native programme forms with explicit individual settings
role.ambitious_version: A physiologist who sees comparable progress clearly and records advice with less repeated setup while keeping individual exercise decisions and personal coaching central.
